title: Juicy Welsh Cod Stew
description: Rich and flavorful stew featuring cod, gochujang, and a hint of Welsh heritage.

ingredients.name: Gochujang
ingredients.notes: Korean chili paste for a spicy kick

ingredients.name: White wine
ingredients.notes: Dry white wine for added depth

instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add diced carrot and potato, cooking for an additional 5 minutes or until they start to brown.
Add gochujang, cod fish stock, and white wine, stirring to combine.
Add cod fillets to the pot, skin side up, if they have skin.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the stew rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes for a filling meal.
